Q8537.reason: Which justification is available depends on which concept of punishment is used, so the concept and the justification have to be kept analytically apart.

Q6097.reason: The gift to the cousin and the heirs of his body left the grantor a reversion if that line failed, and the later deed to the niece passes that reversion.

Q8324.reason: Extreme agitation with aggressive demands for medication fits dopamine-circuit hyperexcitability, whereas cell death or a dopamine deficit would reduce dopamine drive.
